title: Setup: build Apache Calcite at both pins of #5345 and #4942 and run their landed tests
description: Setup for cases R33 (apache/calcite#5345, RexSimplify keeps semantics-changing nested casts) and R34 (apache/calcite#4942, sub-millisecond temporal literals survive constant reduction) of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-r01-r50-brief.md; no claims, no verifier. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-r01-r50/worktrees, with the Gradle cache resolved online there already (inline, 2026-11-26), offline Gradle 8.14.4 on JDK 21 with the build's default JDK 25 compile toolchain: for each case, builds calcite-core, -linq4j and -testkit at the fix and the parent pins, runs the PR's landed test classes (R33: RexLosslessCastTest, RelToSqlConverterTest, CoreQuidemTest with cast.iq; R34: RexExecutorTest, CalciteSqlOperatorTest for the one-line testkit change), keeps the jars with class digests and the core runtime and test classpaths under $O/artifacts/CASE-ROLE/, then overlays the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent and runs them again, where the new tests are expected to fail. Each Calcite core build takes several minutes, so the runs are a job. The last steps delete the build trees.
expected: every step exits 0; the fix and parent steps print 'test rc=0' with their junit summaries in $O/logs/CASE-ROLE.test-offline.junit.txt; each landed step prints LANDED-TESTS-FAIL-ON-PARENT-AS-EXPECTED and names the failing tests in $O/logs/CASE-parent-landed.test-offline.failures.txt; the clean steps print 'cleaned'

resources.notes: 6 offline Calcite builds (core compile ~4-6 min each with buildSrc cached) plus CoreQuidemTest and CalciteSqlOperatorTest runs; Gradle client 512m, daemon 2g, test JVM ~1-2g

steps.name: R33 fix: calcite core/linq4j/testkit jars, RexLosslessCastTest + RelToSqlConverterTest + CoreQuidemTest, jars/classpaths kept
R33 parent: the same with the parent's own test files
R33 landed: the fix's three test files on a copy of the parent (some expected to fail)
R34 fix: calcite jars, RexExecutorTest + CalciteSqlOperatorTest, jars/classpaths kept
R34 parent: the same with the parent's own test files
R34 landed: the fix's test files (RexExecutorTest, testkit SqlOperatorTest) on a copy of the parent (some expected to fail)
